_meta.verdict: ABSENT_FROM_BOTH FOUND — HOLD-FOR-SOL. Per the Sol U4 ruling and the D6-B commission stop conditions, the wave stops at ordered-sequence step 3; no implementation was started.
_meta.method: Deterministic script (no model in the loop): FR API search for Defense Department 'Arms Sales Notification' NOTICE documents published 2026-02-06..2026-08-25 (133 documents scanned, every raw text fetched and sha256-receipted); bracket-header transmittal extraction with the frozen numeric YY-N grammar; 36(b)(5)(C)/RSAT amendment and modification notices (letter-suffixed bracket transmittals, e.g. 26-0G / 0M-25, which reference an earlier original certification) excluded with reason; 'Date Report Delivered to Congress' parsed per document; window filter inclusive. Companion raw receipt: fms_u4_fr_denominator_2026-08-25.json.
_meta.denominator_completeness_note: FR publication lags delivery by ~5-10 weeks in the scanned corpus (worst observed lag inside the corpus: delivered 2026-02-06, published 2026-04-15). By 2026-08-25 every window delivery should long since have published; a certification delivered in the window but still unpublished in FR after ~6 months would be unprecedented in the scanned corpus and cannot be excluded with certainty. Congressional Record was not additionally swept (Sol's ruling permits 'Federal Register and/or Congressional Record').

collateral_findings.finding: STATE-ERA UNDER-COVERAGE IS A STANDING CLASS, NOT A CUTOVER ONE-OFF
collateral_findings.exemplar: Transmittal 26-28 (Government of Japan — Upgraded Hyper Velocity Gliding Projectiles Support, $340M, delivered 2026-03-24, FR 2026-09109 / 91 FR 24848) is absent from the State surface: zero japan slugs in the 46-article corpus, direct slug probes 404 (2026/03, /04, /05). This case is outside the U4 window but proves the State web surface under-covers the 36(b)(1) certification population even in its own era.
collateral_findings.so_what: The FMS read model's coverage semantics cannot equate 'full current State corpus' with 'all current 36(b)(1) certifications'. FR is the more complete official record but is frozen as supplementary (cannot mint cases). Sol must rule how coverage truth is represented before the vertical can honestly ship.

collateral_findings.finding: FR 'Arms Sales Notification' title covers two populations
collateral_findings.detail: Original 36(b)(1) certifications carry numeric bracket transmittals ([Transmittal No. 26-23]); 36(b)(5)(C)/RSAT amendment and modification notices carry letter-suffixed transmittals ([Transmittal No. 26-0G], [Transmittal No. 0M-25]) and reference the original certification they amend (e.g. 26-0G references 17-80). A naive transmittal regex mints a phantom '26-0' case from every amendment notice. The frozen FREEZE §6 grammar's numeric-only rule plus bracket-header site is the correct filter; the D6-B implementation and its kill tests must cover the amendment class explicitly.

collateral_findings.finding: Delivery-to-post lag on State can run weeks
collateral_findings.detail: Several FR-certified State-era cases (26-21 Belgium delivered 2026-03-24, Belgium post appears 2026/05; 26-24 Singapore delivered 2026-04-01, Singapore posts appear 2026/06) show the State web post appearing one-to-two months after certification, unless those posts are different cases entirely (transmittal-level confirmation requires fetching each article body — deferred to implementation). official_web_publication_date must never proxy for official_notification_date (already frozen law, FREEZE §7).
